items.title: Jason Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2025
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Benny Goodman; the mention is made by the interviewer referencing Lionel Hampton's story about Teddy Wilson and Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: Okay, we’ll proceed and it will go off in a while. You know who agrees with you about what you just said is Lionel Hampton. I had the pleasure of talking to him, God, like 25 years ago, and he said, Teddy Wilson used to play when Benny Goodman took an intermission and no white musician was on stage, then Teddy would play by himself. So I was the first one to break that tradition down. But the think about it, there was no black and white playing together no place. Not in moving pictures, not in baseball, football,…
Yeah. Un hum. Yup. There you go.
